lead: Adding a driver to `Core\Db` is one match per member, not one match, and `open`'s arm looks like all of it.
body: `nvs_db::Connection` is destructured at seven sites under `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/` and six end in `other => driverless(...)`, so an arm added to `open` alone hands out a connection that refuses every statement, with no compile error. Count the `Connection::` matches before pricing the slice; a driver sharing MySQL's protocol also needs a seam where `mysql_rows`/`mysql_write` take `&mut nvs_db::MySqlConn` by name.
